case_status.current_case_status_desc_en: On September 5, 2023, we approved your Form I-130, Petition for Alien Relative, Receipt Number LIN9999106505. We sent you an approval notice. Please follow the instructions in the notice.

hist_case_status.completed_text_en: We approved your Form I-130, Petition for Alien Relative.
